title: Tournament prize caption has 4.2087:1 contrast on its tinted background
scope: One completed synthetic tournament detail at CSS widths 405, 789 and 1183. This is a component-level finding, not an assessment of whole-app conformance.

criterion.criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3: at least 4.5:1 for normal text
criterion.whyRelevant: The 12 CSS px, weight700 caption is informational normal-sized text. Original tablet/desktop and supplementary three-width observations report no disabled ancestor. It is not a logo or pure decoration.

method: Normalize each sRGB channel to 0–1. Use c/12.92 when c <= 0.04045, otherwise ((c + 0.055)/1.055)^2.4. Relative luminance is 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B. Contrast is (lighter luminance + 0.05)/(darker luminance + 0.05). Do not round before comparing against the threshold.
assumptions: Original background chains stop at the first opaque card. Separately timestamped supplementary chains reach HTML at all three widths and report opacity1, no background images/filters/backdrop filters, normal blending and visible styles.
Supplementary full-chain observations have withinViewport:false. They validate styles, not a new visible screenshot or identical scroll position.
The contrast calculation uses recorded CSS colors, not antialiased screenshot pixels.
Original screenshot/DOM times differ and remain unchanged. Mobile viewport identity uses the adjacent capture with no intervening resize, as reported.

healthyControls.scope: Original mobile numeric comparison only; not whole-component/all-width acceptance
Original mobile numeric comparison only; not whole-component/all-width acceptance

minimalRecommendation.change: Darken only this caption, for example to the existing darker neutral color #4e5968. That gives 6.4849:1 on the same background. Preserve the main text, backgrounds, fees and award rules.
minimalRecommendation.status: Hypothetical arithmetic example only; not applied, implemented or browser-tested.

deployment.browserServingSHA: Not exposed or independently established; no build-specific attribution.

limits: One synthetic tournament caption at three widths only, not a whole-app conformance audit.
No login/logout, submission, saving, prize/fee change, notification or result change reported.
Body and badge calculations meet4.5 for the original mobile samples; their full state/width coverage is not claimed. Unprovided winner-panel claims are excluded.

Text effects were independently read only in the later desktop observation: textShadow none, strokeWidth0px, textFillColor equal to caption foreground. This is not evidence that those properties were separately recorded at the original mobile/tablet capture times.
Three original safe PNGs only; no previous unrelated images or private original screenshots republished.
